description: This PHP source file defines the ScopeRepository class within the OrangeHRM project, implementing OAuth scope management functionalities by adhering to the ScopeRepositoryInterface. Currently, it provides stub methods for retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scopes, both returning default values indicating that OAuth scopes are not supported or defined at this stage.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: A repository class implementing ScopeRepositoryInterface for handling OAuth scope retrieval and finalization. Currently, methods are stubbed to indicate OAuth scopes are not supported or configured.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a scope entity by its identifier; currently returns null as OAuth scopes are not supported.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes the list of scopes for a given client and grant type; currently returns an empty array as no scopes are configured.
